title: Smoked Flatbread Wrap with Egyptian Spices
description: A hearty, flavorful wrap filled with Egyptian spices and topped with a side of tangy slaw. This vegan dish is perfect for a quick and satisfying meal.

ingredients.name: egyptian spices (paprika, cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper)
tangy slaw (made with red cabbage, apple cider vinegar, and lemon juice)

instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Slice the smoked flatbread into strips and grill until crispy, about 2-3 minutes per side.
In a large bowl, whisk together the Egyptian spices, roasted red peppers, chickpeas, cucumber, and mixed greens.
Add the grilled flatbread strips to the bowl and toss to combine.
Serve immediately, topped with a dollop of tangy slaw and a squeeze of lemon juice, if desired.
Refrigerate any leftovers for up to 24 hours.
